# 07-supporting

Configuration management, change, problem resolution, documentation, review, traceability, tool and software-component qualification, proven in use, release, the integrated process model.

Standard clauses: IEC 61508-1 §6–§7, IEC 61508-3 §7.4, ISO 13849-1 §12, IEC 62443-4-1 SM/DM/SUM, Machinery Regulation Annex IV–V, ASPICE SUP.1/2/7/8/9/10.
